blocks.instructionalPurpose: Sustained reading with words explained in context. Learner action: Read the two paragraphs, then write or say a prediction using might and one supporting detail.

accessibility.textAlternative: Massa and the garden labels: opening. After rain, the names on the school garden labels were hard to read. Massa found the spare labels beside the seedlings. The class planned to share seedlings on Friday. If the names disappeared, visitors might not know which plants they were taking. Massa carried a clean tin under the veranda. She put spare labels inside, but left the lid nearby. 'Will this help us keep the names clear?' she asked. The next shower had not arrived.

blocks.instructionalPurpose: Sustained reading with words explained in context. Learner action: Read both paragraphs and mark one detail that confirms, changes or limits your first prediction.

accessibility.textAlternative: Massa and the garden labels: ending. Massa's class put one spare label on an open bench and another inside the tin under the veranda. Both labels used the same paper and ink. After a shower, the bench label was hard to read. The sheltered label was still clear. The class repeated the comparison after another shower and saw the same pattern. They kept spare labels in the sheltered tin and checked them before sharing the seedlings. They had not tested every kind of rain. If later checks showed a problem, they would change the plan.
